Close cozy three-quarter view of a sunlit cottage kitchen, SAGE GREEN cabinets and large sage wall tiles dominating, warm ivory crockery and an oak bread board with crusty loaf, herbs, a small window. One teacup holding warm tea on board with no steam; one small empty bud vase on sill; one terracotta herb pot with short bare stems; a linen-wrapped loaf with a tied cord center but no decorative bow; an empty short hook under upper shelf. Later details: delicate steam, little flower, herb sprig, linen bow, hanging wooden spoon. All anchor areas comfortably inside image. Sunlight from upper left.
